body: This 2025 Sprinter AWD 170 build in our El Capitan Tier is built for long trips, remote camping, and comfortable life on the road. With a high-capacity Battle Born power system, heated water tanks, indoor tiled shower, full kitchen, Starlink, pop top, king bed, and rugged exterior upgrades, it’s a refined adventure van made to go farther and stay out longer.
